title: check reports a path a check proves absent as gone when it uses test ! -e or sys.exit on an exists test in another form
goal: bl_check.command_paths leaves out a path the command checks is absent in the forms a removal's proof takes beyond BG-gvryjkwc's: an argv check test ! -e PATH (or -f), sys.exit(1 if os.path.exists(PATH) else 0) and sys.exit(int(os.path.exists(PATH))), so check's gone-path warning does not tell an item whose check proves a deletion that it can never pass. Found by the SP-hyp6o7hl review.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_check;q=chr(39);p='os.path.exists('+q+'src/old.txt'+q+')';R=[['test','!','-e','src/old.txt'],['python3','-c','import os,sys;sys.exit(1 if '+p+' else 0)'],['python3','-c','import os,sys;sys.exit(int('+p+'))']];F=[(r,bl_check.command_paths(r)) for r in R];[print(r,'->',f) for r,f in F];sys.exit(1 if any(f for r,f in F) else 0)
